title: YIKES: Jersey's '6600 Illegal Voter Problem' Just Got SO Much Worse
text:
News Clash
YIKES: Jersey’s ‘6600 Illegal Voter Problem’ Just Got SO Much Worse
Where are those Al Gore 'every vote matters' people now?
As if to underscore the urgency of voter security measures, just one day after the press downplayed NJ’s motor voter registration of disqualified illegal immigrants – many of whom cast ballots — we’re seeing VASTLY revised numbers.
Worse, we’re seeing pushback on the ‘glitch’ narrative they used to deflect the severity in the first place.
The answer we were all given was ‘it happened a long time ago’ and ‘only 400 people’ may have voted of the 6600 registered.
Are you CERTAIN about those numbers? REALLY certain?
Because DHS is working from a different starting number.
Appreciate you responding back to our letter,
[@GovSherrillNJ]. This should’ve been done a LONG time ago.Just ONE illegal vote cancels out the vote of a U.S. citizen. As
[@DHSgov]reported last week—New Jersey could have as many as 35,152 potential non-citizens registered to vote.…[https://t.co/HF17hLlOkj]— Secretary Markwayne Mullin (@SecMullinDHS)
[July 21, 2026]
We’re looking at close to 60,000 votes in one state alone.
For historical context, the disputed 2020 vote in Georgia had Biden only about 12,670 votes ahead of Trump. Arizona 10,457. Nevada 33,596. Pennsylvania about 80,000. Wisconsin 20,682.
How many phantom votes exist in other states that have fought tooth-and-nail to block any accountability measures?
Oh, as for the ‘it’s just a glitch’ defence? A ‘glitch’, you say?
A real journalist followed up on that claim, and if the software company is telling the truth, it’s smoking gun evidence of deliberate attempts to overturn the will of the people by flooding the process with illegitimate votes from people with no past or connection to the country that’s being radically remade.
🚨BREAKING: "Overnight, we reached out to the software company that runs New Jersey's [voting] system…they said, 'There is no software glitch at all. The state of New Jersey knew they were putting non-citizens…onto the voter rolls.'"
[@jsolomonReports][pic.twitter.com/4R8NZaVmFQ]— Just the News (@JustTheNews)
[July 22, 2026]
One might even call such a process a ‘fundamental transformation’ of America.
Right Barack?
Whatever happened to the Al Gore days when we were told in the most heart-wrenching and pleading terms that every vote matters by whatever sports or entertainment guru that could be hitched to the cause?
Oh right… such trivialities no longer matter.
Now we’ve go political machines that will swap political candidates in and out like cogs in a machine — Bernie/Hillary, Biden/Kamala, Platner and whoever — with no interest in bothering to consult with the plebs whose votes they claim to crave.
They don’t care if the ballots are real or not, so long as the candidate they are pulling for wins in the end.
